findings.test_recommendation: Build httpd with GCOV instrumentation. Write a test module implementing process_connection hook: verify that OK+CONN_STATE_PROCESSING triggers lingering close (not POLLIN/POLLOUT); verify that AGAIN+CONN_STATE_PROCESSING puts the connection back in the pollset for I/O events. Also verify DONE->OK mapping does not break third-party modules.

Build Apache httpd with mod_http2: verify fallback to clogging_input_filters path on MPMs without AP_MPMQ_CAN_AGAIN; verify AGAIN return triggers correct poll callback on capable MPMs; confirm connection close behavior on non-EOF error states meets expectations; run mod_http2 existing test suite for regressions.
Write a test module simulating pre_connection returning error, verify connection is properly closed with resource cleanup; confirm normal flow (pre_connection returns OK/DONE) is unaffected.
Process_connection hook implementations written per new comment should correctly interact with event MPM by returning AGAIN instead of OK for I/O wait. Verify as described in PCA-0001.
